title: Driving Innovation: The Policy Tools Powering Electric Vehicle Technological Inventions
abstract: Electric vehicles (EVs) are crucial for cutting transportation emissions, yet the policy drivers of EV innovation remain underexplored. This study analyzes firm-level panel data on EV and battery patents, covering more than 4,000 firms across 19 countries from 2010 to 2021, to assess how these policy tools and their interactions in different time horizons influence innovative activity. We test the effects of individual policy instruments that either raise demand for EVs or support the development of EV technologies. Stringent fuel-economy standards, financial incentives, adoption targets, and public R&D investments each significantly increase patenting in EV and battery technologies. Moreover, long-term EV targets amplify the innovative impact of public R&D and standards while diminishing the marginal effect of short-term price signals. The results suggest that governments can accelerate clean automotive innovation by combining long-term adoption commitments with sustained R&D investment or strong performance standards, and by managing these instruments as a coordinated policy portfolio rather than as separate tools. The study contributes cross-country, firm-level evidence that links policy design to the direction of clean technology innovation.
abstract_zh: 电动汽车（EV）对于减少交通排放至关重要，然而，推动电动汽车创新的政策驱动因素仍未得到充分探索。本研究分析了涵盖19个国家、4,000多家企业、2010至2021年间的电动汽车和电池专利企业层面面板数据，以评估这些政策工具及其在不同时间尺度上的相互作用如何影响创新活动。我们检验了提高电动汽车需求或支持电动汽车技术发展的各项单一政策工具的效果。严格的燃油经济性标准、财政激励、采用目标以及公共研发投入，均显著提高了电动汽车和电池技术的专利申请量。此外，长期电动汽车目标放大了公共研发和标准的创新效应，同时削弱了短期价格信号的边际效应。结果表明，政府可以通过将长期采用承诺与持续的研发投入或严格的性能标准相结合，并将这些工具作为协调一致的政策组合而非彼此独立的工具来管理，从而加速清洁汽车创新。本研究提供了跨国、企业层面的证据，将政策设计与清洁技术创新的方向联系起来。

title: Government Funding and the Direction of Academic Energy Research
abstract: Does government funding influence the choice of research topics? Novel grant-making modalities such as the Advanced Research Projects Agency-Energy (ARPA-E) program aim to encourage scientists to take on difficult-to-solve, wicked societal problems such as clean energy. Yet little causal evidence exists linking funding and research direction, with most existing studies focusing on health sciences. We provide new evidence on the effect of funding on clean energy research, addressing two questions: (1) Do scientists change the focus of their research in response to targeted government funding opportunities?(2) If so, what types of calls for funding best attract new researchers? Using data on grants from the Department of Energy and National Science Foundation, we combine text and regression analyses to compare the publication trajectories of funded scientists to a set of matched controls. After funding, the research of funded scientists becomes more similar to the grant topic than that of the matched controls. The effect is largest for ARPA-E, which explicitly aims to attract new scientists to clean energy research, suggesting that agency efforts to attract new researchers to a topic area can succeed. General calls for funding such as offered by traditional NSF directorates generate less movement.
abstract_zh: 政府资助是否会影响研究课题的选择？诸如先进研究计划署能源部门（ARPA-E）项目等新型资助模式，旨在鼓励科学家致力于解决清洁能源等棘手的复杂社会问题。然而，关于资助与研究方向之间因果关系的证据很少，现有研究大多集中于健康科学。我们为资助对清洁能源研究的影响提供了新的证据，回答两个问题：（1）科学家是否会根据有针对性的政府资助机会改变研究重点？（2）如果会，哪类资助项目最能吸引新的研究者？我们使用能源部和国家科学基金会的资助数据，结合文本分析和回归分析，比较获资助科学家与一组匹配对照者的论文发表轨迹。获资助后，获资助科学家的研究比匹配对照者更接近资助课题。该效应在ARPA-E项目中最为显著，因为该项目明确旨在吸引新科学家进入清洁能源研究领域，这表明机构吸引新研究者进入某一研究领域的努力可以取得成效。而NSF传统学科部门等一般性资助项目所引起的研究转向较小。

title: Innovation in Climate Adaptation Technologies in Response to Extreme Weather Events: Evidence from Patent Data
abstract: We analyze innovation of climate adaptation technologies in response to weather extremes. Using patent data and original climate indicators at the country level, we estimate the effects of past extreme droughts, precipitation and heatwaves on patenting for adaptation technologies. Innovation response varies by hazard and technology and is strongest for droughts and heatwaves. The impact of extreme events on innovation also varies across countries depending on their long-term hazard exposure and risk. While higher-risk countries on average patent more adaptation technologies than low-risk countries, innovators are more responsive to extreme weather in countries with lower baseline risk. Our findings suggest that extreme weather is more salient to people living in regions less prone to that hazard and, therefore, the shock is more likely to provide new information and induce a larger behavioral response there.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了气候适应技术对极端天气事件的创新响应。利用专利数据以及国家层面的原始气候指标，我们估计了过去的极端干旱、降水和热浪对适应技术专利申请的影响。创新响应因灾害类型和技术而异，对干旱和热浪的响应最为强烈。极端事件对创新的影响也因各国长期灾害暴露程度和风险水平的不同而有所差异。尽管高风险国家平均申请的适应技术专利多于低风险国家，但创新者在基线风险较低的国家对极端天气的响应更为敏感。我们的发现表明，对于生活在不易遭受该灾害地区的人们而言，极端天气更为显著，因此，这一冲击更有可能提供新信息，并在那里引发更大的行为反应。

title: Not in My Backyard? The Local Impact of Wind and Solar Parks in Brazil
abstract: Support from local citizens is important for the scale-up of renewable energy. We investigate the impact of utility-scale wind and solar parks on employment, GDP and public finances in Brazilian municipalities using a difference-in-differences design with matching. We find a positive employment impact of 1-1.5 jobs/MW in the 15 months preceding the commissioning of a solar park, when the park is under construction, but no impacts thereafter. For wind, we find no employment impacts during the construction phase and potentially a small impact of 0.2-0.25 jobs/MW in the 12 months following commissioning. In the year after commissioning, GDP increases 23% for an average sized solar park and 12% for an average sized wind project. The impacts only decrease slightly in the following years. We also find significant persistent fiscal revenue impacts in wind compared to only a one-time tax revenue increase in solar at the time of construction. Our results provide different implications for policymakers that want to advocate for renewable energy in their towns. While for solar, the main benefit constitutes a short-term increase in low-skilled employment and public revenues, wind energy provides more long-term financial benefits but less local employment opportunities.
abstract_zh: 当地居民的支持对于可再生能源规模的扩大至关重要。我们采用倾向匹配结合双重差分（difference-in-differences）设计，考察大型风电场和太阳能电站对巴西各市就业、GDP和公共财政的影响。我们发现，在太阳能电站并网前的15个月内（即建设期间），每兆瓦带来1–1.5个就业岗位的正向就业效应，但此后没有影响。对于风电，我们在建设阶段未发现就业效应，在并网后的12个月内可能有每兆瓦0.2–0.25个就业岗位的小幅影响。并网后一年，平均规模的太阳能电站使GDP增长23%，平均规模的风电项目使GDP增长12%。此后几年，这些影响仅略有下降。我们还发现，风电带来了显著而持久的财政收入效应，而太阳能仅在建设期间带来一次性的税收增长。我们的结果对希望在本地推动可再生能源发展的政策制定者具有不同的启示。对太阳能而言，主要收益是低技能就业和公共收入的短期增长；而风能则带来更多长期财政收益，但本地就业机会较少。

title: The Law and Economics of Subsidies
Do technology standards induce innovation in environmental technologies when coordination is important?
abstract: If further decarbonization of electricity systems is to continue, a next generation of innovation in transformative grid modernization and renewables integration technologies will be needed. Few studies have investigated the policy determinants of innovation in this sector to glean insights on how government may support the development and deployment of these technologies. We argue that policies that were successful at supporting the first wave of renewables innovation may not be sufficient to produce similar results in the next wave of green innovation since those face higher coordination bottlenecks. We investigate the effects of interoperability standards - an instrument that may facilitate coordination - on patenting using smart grid as an example of a technology that has high interoperability requirements. We find that standards decrease patenting at the extensive and intensive margins, but these results vary across types of firms. We find that this negative effect is driven by large firms, whereas standards increase entry by firms without prior smart grid innovation experience. We interpret this result as an information effect: standards provide useful information to new entrants and may help diversify the range of players innovating in this space.
abstract_zh: 若电力系统的脱碳进程要持续推进，就需要新一代变革性电网现代化和可再生能源整合技术的创新。很少有研究考察该领域创新的政策决定因素，以便深入了解政府如何支持这些技术的开发与部署。我们认为，成功推动第一波可再生能源创新的政策，可能不足以在下一波绿色创新中产生类似效果，因为后者面临更高的协调瓶颈。我们考察了互操作性标准（interoperability standards）这一可能促进协调的工具对专利申请的影响，并以智能电网为例，因为该技术对互操作性有很高的要求。我们发现，标准会在扩展边际和集约边际上减少专利申请，但这些结果在不同类型企业之间存在差异。这一负面效应主要由大企业驱动，而标准则促进了此前没有智能电网创新经验的企业进入。我们将这一结果解释为信息效应：标准为新进入者提供了有用信息，并可能有助于使这一领域的创新参与者更加多元化。

title: Industrial policy, populism and the political economy of climate action
The Next Wave of Energy Innovation: Which Technologies? Which Skills?
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: The costs of low-carbon energy fell dramatically over the past decade, leading to rapid growth in its deployment. However, many challenges remain to deploy low-carbon energy at a scale necessary to meet net zero carbon emission targets. We argue that developing complementary technologies and skills must feature prominently in the next wave of low-carbon energy innovation. These include both improvements in physical capital, such as smart grids to aid integration of intermittent renewables, and human capital, to develop the skills workers need for a low-carbon economy. We document recent trends in energy innovation and discuss the lessons learnt for policy. We then discuss the need for complementary innovation in both physical capital-using smart grids as an example of how policy can help-and human capital, where we show how a task approach to labor informs policy and research on the worker skills needed for the energy transition.
abstract_zh: 过去十年间，低碳能源成本大幅下降，推动了其快速部署。然而，要以达到净零碳排放目标所需的规模部署低碳能源，仍面临诸多挑战。我们认为，发展互补性技术和技能必须在下一波低碳能源创新中占据突出位置。这既包括物理资本的改进，例如有助于整合间歇性可再生能源的智能电网，也包括人力资本，即培养低碳经济所需劳动者技能。我们梳理了近期能源创新的趋势，并讨论了其对政策的启示。随后，我们讨论了物理资本（以智能电网为例，说明政策如何提供帮助）和人力资本方面互补性创新的必要性，并展示了劳动任务方法（task approach）如何为能源转型所需劳动者技能的政策与研究提供依据。

title: Environmental Economics, Regulation, and Innovation
abstract: This paper provides a primer on the economics of environmental innovation. Our intention is not to write a pure review paper, but to also provide an up-to-date textbook treatment on the issue. Thus, we start by defining the marginal costs of both emissions and of emissions abatement. We then analyze theoretically how innovation may affect marginal abatement costs. We also cover the different modelling choices with respect to how the innovation process is represented mathematically and how different environmental policy measures could affect environmental innovation. Our theoretical propositions are all illustrated with examples from the empirical literature. A special emphasis is placed on the recent literature on directed technical change and the potential impact of government intervention in the research and development choices of private firms.
abstract_zh: 本文为环境创新经济学提供入门性介绍。我们的意图不是撰写纯粹的综述论文，而是同时提供一份最新的教科书式讨论。因此，我们首先定义排放的边际成本和减排的边际成本。随后，我们从理论上分析创新如何影响边际减排成本。我们还涵盖了关于如何在数学上表示创新过程的不同建模选择，以及不同环境政策措施如何影响环境创新。我们的理论命题均以实证文献中的例子加以说明。本文特别强调近期关于定向技术变革（directed technical change）的文献，以及政府干预私营企业研发选择的潜在影响。

title: Powering the next wave of green energy innovation
abstract: How solar and wind became cheap is a formidable success story. Whether this success can be emulated in other areas of green energy innovation critical for achieving net-zero emission targets is a different question. During the last two decades, massive innovations changed how energy is generated and used. But many technical challenges remain to scale-up renewables, electrify transportation and decarbonize heavy industry. Achieving this will place unprecedented pressure on the electrical grid to deliver prodigious amounts of clean energy. To cope with these pressures, further R&D efforts must emphasize technologies to complement renewable energy. In the first decade of the 21 st century, innovation played a key role lowering the costs of wind and solar energy. For example, wind turbine rotors more than doubled in size, increasing cost-effectiveness, and new wafer-cutting techniques helped reduce raw materials used in manufacturing solar panels [1].Patenting in these technologies increased by a factor of three or more from 2006 to 2011 (Fig 1).While patents have fallen since, the dramatic decrease in low-carbon energy prices suggests the wave of innovation in the early 2000s succeeded. More concerning, we observe both similar declines and lower innovation levels in technologies that have not yet attained maturity and are critical for achieving decarbonization goals, such as smart grids and hydrogen and fuel cells. Continued innovation in these enabling technologies that complement readily available clean technologies such as intermittent renewables is vital to stay on track to limiting global warming to no more than 1.5˚Celsius [2].What lessons have we learned from the success of wind and solar, and how can they be applied to enabling green energy technologies?
abstract_zh: 太阳能和风能为何变得便宜，是一个令人瞩目的成功故事。这一成功能否在对实现净零排放目标至关重要的绿色能源创新的其他领域复制，则是另一个问题。在过去二十年里，大量创新改变了能源的生产和使用方式。但要扩大可再生能源规模、实现交通电气化以及重工业脱碳，仍有许多技术挑战。要做到这一点，将对电网提出前所未有的压力，要求其输送大量清洁能源。为应对这些压力，进一步的研发努力必须着重于补充可再生能源的技术。21世纪的第一个十年，创新在降低风能和太阳能成本方面发挥了关键作用。例如，风力涡轮机叶片的直径增加了一倍多，从而提高了成本效益；新的晶圆切割技术则帮助减少了太阳能板制造中的原材料用量[1]。这些技术的专利申请量在2006至2011年间增长了三倍甚至更多（图1）。尽管此后专利数量有所下降，但低碳能源价格的急剧下降表明，21世纪初的创新浪潮是成功的。更令人担忧的是，我们观察到，在尚未成熟但对实现脱碳目标至关重要的技术领域（如智能电网、氢能和燃料电池），同样出现了类似的下降，且创新水平更低。持续推进这些使能技术的创新，以补充间歇性可再生能源等现成的清洁技术，对于将全球变暖控制在不超过1.5摄氏度的目标上至关重要[2]。我们从风能和太阳能的成功中吸取了哪些经验？又该如何将这些经验应用于使能性绿色能源技术？

title: The Role of Venture Capital and Governments in Clean Energy: Lessons from the First Cleantech Bubble
abstract: After a boom and bust cycle in the early 2010s, venture capital (VC) investments are, once again, flowing towards green businesses. In this paper, we use Crunchbase data on 150,000 US startups founded between 2000 and 2020 to better understand why VC initially did not prove successful in funding new clean energy technologies. Both lackluster demand and a lower potential for outsized returns make clean energy firms less attractive to VC than startups in ICT or biotech. However, we find no clear evidence that characteristics such as high-capital intensity or long development timeframe are behind the lack of success of VC in clean energy. In addition, our results show that while public sector investments can help attract VC investment, the ultimate success rate of firms receiving public funding remains small. Thus, stimulating demand will have a greater impact on clean energy innovation than investing in startups that will then struggle through the “valley of death”. Rather than investing themselves in startups bound to struggle through the valleys of death, governments wishing to support clean energy startups can first implement demand-side policies that make investing in clean energy more viable.
abstract_zh: 在21世纪前十年初经历了繁荣与萧条的周期之后，风险投资（VC）再次流向绿色企业。本文利用Crunchbase数据库中2000至2020年间成立的15万家美国初创企业数据，以更好地理解风险投资最初为何未能成功资助新的清洁能源技术。需求疲软以及获得超额回报的可能性较低，使清洁能源企业对风险投资的吸引力低于信息通信技术或生物技术初创企业。然而，我们没有发现明确证据表明，高资本密集度或较长的开发周期等特征是风险投资在清洁能源领域失败的原因。此外，我们的结果表明，虽然公共部门投资有助于吸引风险投资，但获得公共资金的企业最终的成功率仍然很低。因此，刺激需求比投资于将在“死亡之谷”中艰难挣扎的初创企业，对清洁能源创新的影响更大。与其自己投资于注定要在“死亡之谷”中挣扎的初创企业，希望支持清洁能源初创企业的政府，可以首先实施需求侧政策，使清洁能源投资变得更加可行。

title: Innovation and Entrepreneurship in the Energy Sector
venue: The Role of Innovation and Entrepreneurship in Economic Growth

title: Induced innovation in energy technologies and systems: a review of evidence and potential implications for CO2 mitigation
The Employment Impact of Green Fiscal Push: Evidence from the American Recovery Act
abstract: We evaluate the employment effect of the green part of the largest fiscal stimulus in recent history, the American Recovery and Reinvestment Act (ARRA).Each $1 million of green ARRA created 15 new jobs that emerged especially in the post-ARRA period (2013)(2014)(2015)(2016)(2017).We find little evidence of significant short-run employment gains. Green ARRA creates more jobs in commuting zones with a greater prevalence of pre-existing green skills. Nearly half of the jobs created by green ARRA investments were in construction or waste management. Nearly all new jobs created are manual labor positions. Nonetheless, manual labor wages did not increase.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了美国《复苏与再投资法案》（ARRA）这一近代史上规模最大的财政刺激计划中绿色部分的就业效应。每100万美元的绿色ARRA资金创造了15个新就业岗位，这些岗位主要出现在ARRA之后的时期（2013至2017年）。我们几乎没有发现短期内就业显著增长的证据。绿色ARRA在既有绿色技能比例较高的通勤区创造了更多就业。绿色ARRA投资所创造的就业岗位中，近一半属于建筑或废弃物管理行业。几乎所有新增就业岗位都是体力劳动岗位。尽管如此，体力劳动者的工资并未因此提高。

title: Green Stimulus in a Postpandemic Recovery: the Role of Skills for a Resilient Recovery
Promoting Clean Energy Innovation at the State and Local Level
abstract: Innovation is an important part of energy policy, and encouraging clean energy innovation is often an explicit goal of policy makers. For local governments, promoting clean energy innovation is seen not only as a pathway to a cleaner economy but also as a tool for promoting the local economy. But is such optimism warranted? There is a substantial literature examining the relationships between innovation and environmental policy, but few studies focus explicitly on innovation at the state and local level. In this paper, I provide key lessons from research on clean energy innovation, focusing on lessons relevant for state and local governments. I then summarize the results of a recent working paper by Fu et al. (2018) that studied wind energy innovation across individual states in the United States. While state-level policies can promote clean energy innovation, it is overall market size that matters most. Thus, innovation need not occur in those states most actively promoting clean energy. I conclude with lessons for state and local governments drawn from both this work and the broader literature on energy innovation.
abstract_zh: 创新是能源政策的重要组成部分，鼓励清洁能源创新往往是政策制定者的明确目标。对地方政府而言，推动清洁能源创新不仅被视为通向更清洁经济的途径，也被视为促进地方经济的工具。但这种乐观是否有依据？大量文献考察了创新与环境政策之间的关系，但很少有研究明确关注州和地方层面的创新。在本文中，我提炼了清洁能源创新研究的关键经验，重点关注与州和地方政府相关的启示。随后，我总结了Fu等（2018）近期一份工作论文的结果，该研究考察了美国各州的风能创新。虽然州级政策可以促进清洁能源创新，但总体而言，市场规模才是最重要的因素。因此，创新未必发生在那些最积极推动清洁能源的州。最后，我基于这项工作以及更广泛的能源创新文献，总结了对州和地方政府的启示。

title: Environmental Policy and Innovation: A Decade of Research
venue: International Review of Environmental and Resource Economics
abstract: Innovation is an important part of environmental policy, and encouraging innovation is often an explicit goal of policymakers. A large literature in environmental economics examines the links between environmental policy and innovation. Popp et al. (2010) provides an extensive review of the literature on environmental innovation. This paper updates that review, highlighting research published during the past decade, with a focus on empirical research examining links between environmental policy and environmentally friendly innovation. I highlight major trends in the literature, including an increased number of cross-country studies and a focus on the effect of different policy instruments on innovation. I include a discussion of the justifications and evidence for technology-specific policy incentives and present evidence on the effectiveness of government R&D spending. My review concludes with a discussion of three promising areas for new research on environmental innovation.
abstract_zh: 创新是环境政策的重要组成部分，鼓励创新往往是政策制定者的明确目标。环境经济学中有大量文献考察环境政策与创新之间的联系。Popp等（2010）对环境创新文献进行了广泛综述。本文更新了该综述，重点关注过去十年发表的研究，侧重于考察环境政策与环境友好型创新之间联系的实证研究。我强调了文献中的主要趋势，包括跨国研究数量的增加，以及对不同政策工具对创新影响的关注。我讨论了针对特定技术的政策激励的理由和证据，并呈现了政府研发支出有效性的证据。综述的最后讨论了环境创新领域三个有前景的新研究方向。

title: Bridging the Gap: Do Fast Reacting Fossil Fuel Technologies Facilitate Renewable Energy Diffusion?
abstract: The diffusion of renewable energy in the power system implies high supply variability. Lacking economically viable storage options, renewable energy integration has so far been possible thanks to the presence of fast-reacting mid-merit fossil-based technologies, which act as back-up capacity. This paper discusses the role of fossil-based power generation technologies in supporting renewable energy investments. We study the deployment of these two technologies conditional on all other drivers in 26 OECD countries between 1990 and 2013.We show that a 1% percent increase in the share of fast-reacting fossil generation capacity is associated with a 0.88% percent increase in renewable in the long run. These results are robust to various modifications in our empirical strategy, and most notably to the use of system-GMM techniques to account for the interdependence of renewable and fast-reacting fossil investment decisions. Our analysis points to the substantial indirect costs of renewable energy integration and highlights the complementarity of investments in different generation technologies for a successful decarbonization process.
abstract_zh: 可再生能源在电力系统中的扩散意味着供应的高度波动性。由于缺乏经济可行的储能选择，可再生能源的整合迄今一直依赖于快速响应的中间负荷化石能源技术，这些技术充当备用容量。本文讨论了化石能源发电技术在支持可再生能源投资中的作用。我们研究了1990至2013年间26个经合组织（OECD）国家中，在其他所有驱动因素既定的条件下，这两类技术的部署情况。我们发现，快速响应化石发电容量的份额每增加1%，长期而言与可再生能源份额增加0.88%相关。这些结果在对实证策略进行多种修改后依然稳健，尤其是在使用系统GMM方法以考虑可再生能源与快速响应化石能源投资决策之间的相互依赖性时。我们的分析指出了可再生能源整合的大量间接成本，并强调了不同发电技术投资在成功实现脱碳过程中的互补性。

title: Encouraging Innovation that Protects Environmental Systems: Five Policy Proposals
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy

title: Environmental Regulation and Green Skills: an empirical exploration
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: This paper provides new evidence on the workplace skills most relevant in the transition toward environmentally sustainable economies. Using a novel data-driven methodology, we identify two main sets of green skills, namely, engineering skills for the design and production of technology, and managerial skills for implementing and monitoring environmental organizational practices. Exploiting exogenous geographical variation in regulatory stringency, we also evaluate the effect of environmental regulation on the demand of green skills for a panel of US metropolitan and nonmetropolitan areas over the period 2006–14. The main finding is that while these changes in environmental regulation have no impact on overall employment, they create significant, if modest, gaps in the demand for some green skills, especially those related to technical and engineering work tasks.
abstract_zh: 本文就向环境可持续经济转型中最相关的工作场所技能提供了新证据。利用一种新颖的数据驱动方法，我们识别出两类主要的绿色技能：用于技术设计与生产的工程技能，以及用于实施和监测环境组织实践的管理技能。利用美国大都市和非大都市地区在环境监管严格程度上的外生地理差异，我们还评估了2006至2014年间环境监管对绿色技能需求的影响。主要发现是：尽管环境监管的这些变化对总体就业没有影响，但它们确实在某些绿色技能的需求上造成了显著（尽管幅度不大）的缺口，尤其是与技术和工程工作任务相关的技能。

title: Technological Spillover Effects of State Renewable Energy Policy: Evidence from Patent Counts
abstract: We examine the effect of in-state and out-of-state renewable energy policies on wind energy patenting. Using a semiparametric fixed-effects Tobit model, we regress patent counts on a series of policy variables within a state and a spatially weighted average for each of these policies implemented in other states. We develop a lower bound for the marginal effects and find important differences across policy types. For renewable portfolio standards, overall demand matters. Policies in other states increase innovation, but own-state policies do not. In contrast, for financial incentives such as tax incentives and subsidy policies, own-state policies induce innovation.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了州内和州外可再生能源政策对风能专利申请的影响。我们使用半参数固定效应Tobit模型，将专利数量对一个州内的一系列政策变量，以及其他州实施的每项政策的空间加权平均值进行回归。我们推导出边际效应的下界，并发现不同政策类型之间存在重要差异。对于可再生能源配额制，整体需求很重要：其他州的政策会促进创新，但本州政策则不会。相比之下，对于税收激励和补贴等财政激励措施，本州政策能够诱发创新。

title: Fiscal and Regulatory Instruments for Clean Technology Development in the European Union
venue: Energy Tax and Regulatory Policy in Europe: Reform Priorities

title: From Science to Technology: The Value of Knowledge From Different Energy Research Institutions
abstract: Using an original data set of both scientific articles and patents pertaining to alternative energy technologies, this paper provides new evidence on the flows of knowledge between university, private sector, and government research. Better understanding of the value of knowledge from these institutions can help decision makers target R&D funds where they are most likely to be successful.I use citation data from both scientific articles and patents to answer two questions. First, what information is most useful to the development of new technology? Does high quality science lead to commercial success?I find that this is the case, as those articles most highly cited by other scientific articles are also more likely to be cited by future patents. Second, which institutions produce the most valuable research? Are there differences across technologies? Research performed at government institutions appears to play an important translational role linking basic and applied research, as government articles are more likely to be cited by patents than any other institution, including universities. Universities play a less important role in wind research than for solar and biofuels, suggesting that wind energy research is at a more applied stage where commercialization and final product development is more important than basic research.
abstract_zh: 利用一个同时包含科学论文和专利（涉及替代能源技术）的原始数据集，本文为大学、私营部门和政府研究机构之间的知识流动提供了新证据。更好地理解这些机构知识的价值，有助于决策者将研发资金投向最有可能成功的地方。我使用科学论文和专利的引用数据回答两个问题。第一，哪些信息对新技术的开发最有用？高质量的科学是否会带来商业成功？我发现确实如此：那些被其他科学论文引用最多的论文，也更有可能被未来的专利引用。第二，哪些机构产出的研究最有价值？不同技术之间是否存在差异？政府机构的研究似乎发挥着重要的转化作用，将基础研究与应用研究联系起来：政府机构发表的论文比包括大学在内的任何其他机构的论文都更有可能被专利引用。大学在风能研究中的作用不如在太阳能和生物燃料研究中重要，这表明风能研究处于更具应用性的阶段，其中商业化和最终产品开发比基础研究更为重要。

title: Intellectual Returnees as Drivers of Indigenous Innovation: Evidence from the Chinese Photovoltaic Industry
Inter-temporal R&D and Capital Investment Portfolios for the Electricity Industry's Low Carbon Future
abstract: A pressing question facing policy makers today in developing a long-term strategy to manage carbon emissions from the electric power sector is how to appropriately balance investment in R&D for driving innovation in emerging low- and zerocarbon technologies with investment in commercially available technologies for meeting existing energy needs. Likewise, policy makers need to determine how to allocate limited funding across multiple technologies. Unfortunately, existing modeling tools to study these questions lack a realistic representation of electric power system operations, the innovation process, or both. In this paper, we present a new modeling framework for long-term R&D and electricity generation capacity planning that combines an economic representation of endogenous non-linear technical change with a detailed representation of the power system. The model captures the complementary nature of technologies in the power sector; physical integration constraints of the system; and the opportunity to build new knowledge capital as a non-linear function of R&D and accumulated knowledge, reflective of the diminishing marginal returns to research inherent in the energy innovation process. Through a series of numerical experiments and sensitivity analyses— with and without carbon policy—we show how using frameworks that do not incorporate these features can over- or under-estimate the value of different emerging technologies, and potentially misrepresent the cost-effectiveness of R&D opportunities.
abstract_zh: 决策者在制定管理电力行业碳排放的长期战略时，面临的一个紧迫问题是：如何适当平衡对新兴低碳和零碳技术的研发投资（以推动创新）与对满足现有能源需求的商业化技术的投资。同样，政策制定者还需要决定如何在多种技术之间分配有限的资金。遗憾的是，现有用于研究这些问题的建模工具缺乏对电力系统运行、创新过程，或两者兼而有之的现实刻画。在本文中，我们提出了一个用于长期研发和发电容量规划的新建模框架，它将内生非线性技术变革的经济学表示与电力系统的详细刻画相结合。该模型刻画了电力行业中技术的互补性、系统的物理整合约束，以及建设新知识资本的机会——后者是研发和累积知识的非线性函数，反映了能源创新过程中研究的边际收益递减。通过一系列数值实验和敏感性分析（包括有无碳政策两种情形），我们展示了不包含这些特征的框架可能会高估或低估不同新兴技术的价值，并可能误判研发机会的成本效益。

title: Should We Give Up After Solyndra? Optimal Technology R&D Portfolios under Uncertainty
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists

title: Economic Analysis of Scientific Publications and Implications for Energy Research and Development
The Learning Process and Technological Change in Wind Power: Evidence from China's CDM Wind Projects
venue: Journal of Policy Analysis and Management
abstract: The Clean Development Mechanism (CDM) is a project-based carbon trade mechanism that subsidizes the users of climate-friendly technologies and encourages technology transfer. The CDM has provided financial support for a large share of Chinese wind projects since 2002.Using pooled cross-sectional data of 486 registered CDM wind projects in China from 2002 to 2009, we examine the determinants of technological change in wind power from a learning perspective. We estimate the effects of different channels of learning-learning through R&D in wind turbine manufacturing, learning from previous experience of installation, and learning through the network interaction between project developer and turbine manufacturer-on technological change, measured as reductions in projected costs or as increased capacity factor across CDM wind projects. While we find that a manufacturer's R&D and previous installation experience matter, interactions between wind turbine manufacturers and wind project developer lead to the largest cost reductions. Whereas existing literature suggests that wind power firms can learn from the experience of other wind farm developers, our results indicate that wind power firms mainly learn from their own experience and that knowledge spillovers mostly occur within certain partnerships between wind project developer and foreign turbine manufacturers in China's wind power industry.
abstract_zh: 清洁发展机制（CDM）是一种以项目为基础的碳交易机制，它对气候友好型技术的使用者提供补贴，并鼓励技术转让。自2002年以来，CDM为中国大量风电项目提供了资金支持。利用2002至2009年中国486个已注册CDM风电项目的混合截面数据，我们从学习的视角考察了风电技术变革的决定因素。我们估计了不同学习渠道的效应（包括通过风机制造研发的学习、从以往安装经验中的学习，以及通过项目开发商与风机制造商之间的网络互动进行的学习）对技术变革的影响，技术变革以预测成本的降低或CDM风电项目容量系数的提高来衡量。虽然我们发现，制造商的研发和以往的安装经验均有影响，但风机制造商与风电项目开发商之间的互动带来了最大的成本下降。现有文献认为风电企业可以从其他风电场开发商的经验中学习，而我们的结果表明，风电企业主要从自身经验中学习，知识溢出主要发生在中国风电行业中开发商与外国风机制造商之间的特定合作关系之中。

title: Climate-Friendly Technological Change for Developing Countries
venue: Oxford Handbook of the Macroeconomics of Global Warming

title: Introduction to the Special Issue on Climate Adaptation: Improving the connection between empirical research and integrated assessment models
Necessity as the Mother of Invention: Innovative Responses to Natural Disasters
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: How do innovators respond to the shock of a natural disaster? Do natural disasters spur technical innovations that can reduce the risk of future hazards? This paper examines the impact of three types of natural disasters including earthquakes, droughts and flooding on the innovation of their respective mitigation technologies. Using patent and disaster data, our study is the first to relate natural disasters to technology innovation, and also presents the first attempt to empirically examine adaptation responses to climate change across multiple sectors at the country level. Overall, we show that natural disasters lead to more risk-mitigating innovations, while the degree of influence varies across different types of disasters and technologies.
abstract_zh: 创新者如何应对自然灾害的冲击？自然灾害是否会刺激能够降低未来灾害风险的技术创新？本文考察了地震、干旱和洪涝三类自然灾害对其各自减灾技术创新的影响。利用专利数据和灾害数据，我们的研究首次将自然灾害与技术创新联系起来，也首次尝试在国家层面、跨多个部门实证检验对气候变化的适应性响应。总体而言，我们发现自然灾害会带来更多降低风险的创新，但影响程度因灾害类型和技术的不同而有所差异。

title: Modeling climate change feedbacks and adaptation responses: recent approaches and shortcomings
Technology Variation vs. R&D Uncertainty: What Matters Most for Energy Patent Success?
abstract: R&D is an uncertain activity with highly skewed outcomes. Nonetheless, most recent empirical studies and modeling estimates of the potential of technological change focus on the average returns to research and development (R&D) for a composite technology and contain little or no information about the distribution of returns to R&D-which could be important for capturing the range of costs associated with climate change mitigation policies-by individual technologies. Through an empirical study of patent citation data, this paper adds to the literature on returns to energy R&D by focusing on the behavior of the most successful innovations for six energy technologies, allowing us to determine whether uncertainty or differences in technologies matter most for success. We highlight two key results. First, we compare the results from an aggregate analysis of six energy technologies to technology-by-technology results. Our results show that existing work that assumes diminishing returns but assumes one generic technology is too simplistic and misses important differences between more successful and less successful technologies. Second, we use quantile regression techniques to learn more about patents that have a high positive error term in our regressions -that is, patents that receive many more citations than predicted based on observable characteristics. We find that differences across technologies, rather than differences across quantiles within technologies, are more important. The value of successful technologies persists longer than those of less successful technologies, providing evidence that success is the culmination of several advances building upon one another, rather than resulting from one single breakthrough. Diminishing returns to research efforts appear most problematic during rapid increases of research investment, such as experienced by solar energy in the 1970s.
abstract_zh: 研发是一项具有高度偏态结果的不确定活动。尽管如此，大多数近期关于技术变革潜力的实证研究和建模估计，都关注研发（R&D）的平均回报，且针对的是一种综合性技术，几乎没有或完全没有关于各项技术研发回报分布的信息。而这一信息对于刻画与气候变化减缓政策相关的成本范围可能非常重要。本文通过对专利引用数据的实证研究，聚焦于六种能源技术中最成功创新的表现，从而为能源研发回报的文献作出贡献，使我们能够判断不确定性还是技术差异对成功最为重要。我们强调两个关键结果。第一，我们将六种能源技术的总体分析结果与逐项技术的结果进行了比较。结果表明，既有研究假设收益递减但只考虑一种通用技术，过于简化，忽略了成功与不成功技术之间的重要差异。第二，我们使用分位数回归技术，考察回归中误差项为较大正值的专利，即获得的引用远超基于可观测特征预测值的专利。我们发现，技术之间的差异比同一技术内部不同分位数之间的差异更为重要。成功技术的价值持续时间比不成功技术更长，这表明成功是多项相互衔接的进步累积的结果，而非单一突破的产物。收益递减问题在研发投入快速增长时最为突出，例如20世纪70年代的太阳能。

title: The Clean Development Mechanism and Neglected Environmental Technologies
Where Does Energy R&D Come From? Examining Crowding out from energy R&D
Environmental Policy vs. Public Pressure: Innovation and Diffusion of Alternative Bleaching Technologies in the Pulp Industry
International Technology Transfer, Climate Change, and the Clean Development Mechanism
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: As the developed world begins efforts to limit its emissions of greenhouse gases, economic growth in developing countries is causing increased emissions from the developing world. Reducing these emissions while still enabling developing countries to grow requires the use of climate-friendly technologies in these countries. In most cases, these technologies are first created in high-income countries. Thus, the challenge for climate policy is to encourage the transfer of these climate-friendly technologies to the developing world. This article reviews the economic literature on environmental technology transfer and discusses the implications of this literature for climate policy, focusing on the Clean Development Mechanism (CDM). A key point is that technology diffusion is gradual. Early adoption of policy by developed countries leads to the development of new technologies that make it easier for developing countries to reduce pollution as well. Since clean technologies are first developed in the world's leading economies, international trade and foreign investments provide access to these technologies. Moreover, evidence suggests that some technologies, such as those enhancing energy efficiency, will diffuse to developing countries even without the aid of policy prescriptions, such as the CDM. This is important for assessing the potential emissions reductions of proposed CDM projects.
abstract_zh: 随着发达国家开始努力限制温室气体排放，发展中国家的经济增长正导致其排放增加。要在减少这些排放的同时让发展中国家继续增长，就需要在这些国家使用气候友好型技术。在大多数情况下，这些技术最初是在高收入国家创造的。因此，气候政策面临的挑战是鼓励这些气候友好型技术向发展中世界转移。本文回顾了关于环境技术转让的经济学文献，并讨论了该文献对气候政策的启示，重点关注清洁发展机制（CDM）。一个关键观点是，技术扩散是渐进的。发达国家的早期政策采用会促使新技术的发展，从而使发展中国家也更容易减少污染。由于清洁技术首先在世界领先经济体中开发，国际贸易和外国直接投资为获取这些技术提供了途径。此外，有证据表明，某些技术（如提高能效的技术）即使没有CDM等政策措施的帮助，也会扩散到发展中国家。这对于评估拟议CDM项目的潜在减排量十分重要。

title: Technology and the Diffusion of Renewable Energy
Trade, Technology, and the Environment: Does Access to Technology Promote Environmental Regulation
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Focusing specifically on regulation of coal-fired power plants, we examine how technological innovation by early adopters influences the timing of new environmental regulation in non-innovating countries. We build a general equilibrium model of an open economy to identify the political-economy determinants of regulation. With a newly created dataset of SO2 and NOx regulations for coal-fired power plants and a patent-based measure of the technology frontier, we estimate the determinants of environmental regulation diffusion. Our findings support the hypothesis that international economic integration eases access to environmentally friendly technologies and leads to earlier adoption, ceteris paribus, of regulation in non-innovating countries. However, we also find evidence that domestic trade protection promotes earlier adoption allowing shifts of regulatory costs to domestic consumers. Furthermore, international market power permits large countries to shift costs to foreign consumers. Other political economy factors, such as the quality of domestic coal, are also important determinants.
abstract_zh: 本文专门聚焦于燃煤电厂的监管，考察早期采用者的技术创新如何影响非创新国家新环境监管的时间。我们构建了一个开放经济的一般均衡模型，以识别监管的政治经济决定因素。借助新建立的燃煤电厂SO₂和NOₓ监管数据集，以及基于专利的技术前沿衡量指标，我们估计了环境监管扩散的决定因素。我们的发现支持以下假说：国际经济一体化使非创新国家更容易获得环境友好型技术，并在其他条件相同的情况下，促使这些国家更早采用监管。然而，我们也发现证据表明，国内贸易保护会促使更早采用监管，从而使监管成本转嫁给国内消费者。此外，国际市场势力使大国能够将成本转嫁给外国消费者。其他政治经济因素，例如国内煤炭的质量，也是重要的决定因素。

title: China and India as Suppliers of Affordable Medicines to Developing Countries
Energy, the Environment, and Technological Change
venue: Handbook of the Economics of Innovation

title: Exploring the Links Between Innovation and Diffusion: Adoption of NOX Control Technologies at U.S. Coal-fired Power Plants
abstract: While many studies have looked at innovation and adoption of technologies separately, the two processes are linked. Advances (and expected advances) in a single technology should affect both its adoption rate and the adoption of alternative technologies. Moreover, advances made abroad may affect adoption differently than improvements developed domestically. This paper combines plant-level data on U.S. coal-fired electric power plants with patent data pertaining to NOx pollution control techniques to study these links.I show that technological advances, particularly those made abroad, are important for the adoption of newer post-combustion treatment technologies, but have little effect on the adoption of older combustion modification techniques. Moreover, I provide evidence that adaptive R&D by U.S. firms is necessary before foreign innovations are adopted in the U.S. Expectations of future technological advances delay adoption. Nonetheless, as in other studies of environmental technologies, the effect of other explanatory variables is dominated by the effect of environmental regulations, demonstrating that the mere presence of environmental technologies is not enough to encourage its usage.
abstract_zh: 尽管许多研究分别考察了创新和技术采用，但这两个过程是相互关联的。单一技术的进步（及对其进步的预期）既会影响该技术的采用率，也会影响替代技术的采用。此外，国外取得的进步对采用的影响可能与国内开发的改进不同。本文将美国燃煤发电厂的电厂级数据与关于NOₓ污染控制技术的专利数据相结合，以研究这些联系。我证明，技术进步，尤其是国外取得的进步，对于较新的燃烧后处理技术的采用十分重要，但对较老的燃烧改进技术的采用影响很小。此外，我提供了证据表明，美国企业的适应性研发是外国创新在美国被采用之前所必需的。对未来技术进步的预期会推迟采用。尽管如此，与其他关于环境技术的研究一样，其他解释变量的效应被环境监管的效应所主导，这表明仅仅存在环境技术本身并不足以促进其使用。

title: Information Disclosure Policy: Does States' Data Processing Efforts Help More than the Information Disclosure Itself?
venue: Journal of Policy Analysis and Management

title: Innovation and Climate Policy
abstract: Reducing emissions of the greenhouse gases that cause climate change will require dramatic changes in the way that energy is produced and consumed. The cost of technological changes such as alternative energy sources and improved energy efficiency will play a large role in determining the overall cost of combating climate change. The development of these technologies will be heavily influenced by government policy. Both environmental and R&D policies provide incentives encouraging the development of clean technologies. Understanding the incentives provided by these policies, and their influence on the development of new technologies, is important for understanding the ultimate effects of climate policy. This chapter reviews the literature on environmental innovation and diffusion, with a focus on studies relevant to the development of clean energy technologies necessary to address climate change.I discuss the implications of this literature for the development of climate policy.
abstract_zh: 减少导致气候变化的温室气体排放，将需要对能源的生产和消费方式作出重大改变。替代能源和提高能效等技术变革的成本，将在很大程度上决定应对气候变化的总成本。这些技术的发展将深受政府政策的影响。环境政策和研发政策都为清洁技术的开发提供了激励。理解这些政策所提供的激励及其对新技术发展的影响，对于理解气候政策的最终效果十分重要。本章回顾了关于环境创新与扩散的文献，重点关注与应对气候变化所需清洁能源技术开发相关的研究。我讨论了这些文献对气候政策的启示。

title: Meaningful Technology Transfer for Climate Disruption
Renewable Energy Policies and Technological Innovation: Evidence Based on Patent Counts
abstract: This paper examines the effect of environmental policies on technological innovation in the specific case of renewable energy. The analysis is conducted using patent data on a panel of 25 countries over the period 1978-2003.It is found that public policy plays a significant role in determining patent applications. Different types of policy instruments are effective for different renewable energy sources.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了环境政策对可再生能源领域技术创新的影响。分析使用了1978至2003年25个国家的专利数据面板。研究发现，公共政策在决定专利申请方面发挥着重要作用。不同类型的政策工具对不同的可再生能源形式有效。

title: Technology Transfer: Alternative Perspective
Does Regulation Stimulate Technical Productive Efficiency? The Effect of Air Quality Policies on the Efficiency of U.S. Power Plants
Endogenizing Technological Change: Matching Empirical Evidence to Modeling Needs
Policy vs. Consumer Pressure: Innovation and Diffusion of Alternative Bleaching Technologies in the Pulp Industry
venue: Environmental Policy, Technological Innovation, and Patents

title: The Effects of Innovation Policies on Private R&D Investment: A Cross-national Empirical Study
venue: Economics of Innovation and New Technology

title: Comparison of Climate Policies in the ENTICE-BR Model
abstract: This paper uses the ENTICE-BR model to study the effects of various climate stabilization policies. Because the ENTICE-BR model includes benefits from reduced climate damages, it is possible to calculate the net economic impact of each policy. In general, only the least restrictive concentration limit is welfare enhancing. While the policies are welfare enhancing in simulations using optimistic assumptions about the potential of the backstop energy technology, such assumptions mean that the backstop is also used in the no-policy base case, so that climate change itself is less of a problem. Finally, assumptions about the nature of R&D markets are important. Removing the assumption of partial crowding out from energy R&D nearly doubles the gains from policy-induced energy R&D.
abstract_zh: 本文利用ENTICE-BR模型，研究各种气候稳定政策的效果。由于ENTICE-BR模型纳入了减少气候损害所带来的收益，因此可以计算每项政策的净经济影响。总体而言，只有最宽松的浓度限值才能增进福利。尽管在使用关于替代能源技术潜力的乐观假设进行模拟时，各项政策都能增进福利，但这些假设意味着在无政策基准情景中替代能源也会被使用，因此气候变化本身的问题就不那么严重了。最后，关于研发市场性质的假设非常重要。去除能源研发中部分挤出效应的假设后，政策诱导的能源研发收益几乎翻了一番。

title: ENTICE-BR: Backstop Technology in the ENTICE Model of Climate Change
Innovation in Climate Policy Models: Implementing Lessons from the Economics of R&D
International Innovation and Diffusion of Air Pollution Control Technologies: The Effects of NOX and SO2 Regulation in the U.S., Japan, and Germany
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Using patent data from the United States, Japan, and Germany, this paper examines both the innovation and diffusion of air pollution control equipment. Whereas the United States was an early adopter of stringent sulfur dioxide (SO2) standards, both Japan and Germany introduced stringent nitrogen dioxide (NOX) standards much earlier than the US.Nonetheless, in both cases, tightened standards in the U.S. led to more domestic patenting, but not more foreign patenting. Overall, the data suggest that inventors respond to environmental regulatory pressure in their own country, but not to foreign environmental regulations. Moreover, any technology transfer that occurs appears to be indirect. Domestic innovation occurs even for technologies that have already experienced significant innovative activity abroad. Moreover, utilities in countries that adopt regulations later nonetheless purchase pollution abatement equipment from domestic firms. However, patent citation data from the U.S. show that earlier foreign patents are an important building block for NOX pollution control innovations in the U.S., suggesting that American inventors build on technological advances made in countries that adopted stringent regulation earlier.
abstract_zh: 本文利用美国、日本和德国的专利数据，考察了空气污染控制设备的创新与扩散。美国是严格二氧化硫（SO₂）标准的早期采用者，而日本和德国引入严格的二氧化氮（NOₓ）标准则比美国早得多。尽管如此，在这两种情形下，美国收紧标准都带动了国内专利申请的增加，但并未带动国外专利申请的增加。总体而言，数据表明，发明者会对本国的环境监管压力作出反应，但不会对外国的环境监管作出反应。此外，任何发生的技术转让似乎都是间接的。即使是已在国外经历过大量创新活动的技术，国内创新仍然会发生。此外，采用监管较晚的国家的公用事业单位，仍然会从国内企业购买污染减排设备。然而，美国的专利引用数据表明，较早的国外专利是美国NOₓ污染控制创新的重要基础，这表明美国的发明者是在那些较早采用严格监管的国家所取得的技术进步基础上进行创新的。

title: R&D Subsidies and Climate Policy: Is there a 'Free Lunch'?
abstract: Because of the long-term nature of the climate problem, technological advances are often seen as an important component of any solution. However, when considering the potential for technology to help solve the climate problem, two market failures exist which lead to underinvestment in climate-friendly R&D: environmental externalities and the public goods nature of new knowledge. As a result, government subsidies to climate-friendly R&D projects are often proposed as part of a policy solution. Using the ENTICE model, I analyze the effectiveness of such subsidies, both with and without other climate policies, such as a carbon tax. While R&D subsidies do lead to significant increases in climate-friendly R&D, this R&D has little impact on the climate itself. Subsidies address the problem of knowledge as a public good, but they do not address the environmental externality, and thus offer no additional incentive to adopt new technologies. Moreover, high opportunity costs to R&D limit the potential role that subsidies can play. While R&D subsidies can improve efficiency, policies that directly affect the environmental externality have a much larger impact on both atmospheric temperature and economic welfare.
abstract_zh: 由于气候问题具有长期性，技术进步通常被视为任何解决方案的重要组成部分。然而，在考虑技术解决气候问题的潜力时，存在两类导致气候友好型研发投资不足的市场失灵：环境外部性以及新知识的公共品属性。因此，政府对气候友好型研发项目的补贴常被提议作为政策方案的一部分。我使用ENTICE模型，分析了此类补贴在单独实施及与碳税等其他气候政策共同实施时的效果。虽然研发补贴确实显著增加了气候友好型研发，但这些研发对气候本身的影响很小。补贴解决了知识作为公共品的问题，但并未解决环境外部性问题，因此不会额外激励采用新技术。此外，研发的高机会成本限制了补贴可能发挥的潜在作用。尽管研发补贴可以提高效率，但直接作用于环境外部性的政策，对大气温度和经济福利的影响要大得多。

title: The Transition to Endogenous Technical Change in Climate-Economy Models: A Technical Overview to the Innovation Modeling Comparison Project
abstract: This paper assesses endogenous technical change (ETC) in climate-economy models, using the models in the Innovation Modeling Comparison Project (IMCP) as a representative cross-section. ETC is now a feature of most leading models. Following the new endogenous growth literature and the application of learning curves to the energy sector, there are two main concepts employed: knowledge capital and learning curves. The common insight is that technical change is driven by the development of knowledge capital and its characteristics of being partly non-rival and partly non-excludable. There are various different implementations of ETC. Recursive CGE models face particular difficulties in incorporating ETC and increasing returns. The main limitations of current models are: the lack of uncertainty analysis; the limited representation of the diffusion of technology; and the homogeneous nature of agents in the models including the lack of representation of institutional structures in the innovation process.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了气候—经济模型中的内生技术变革（ETC），以创新建模比较项目（IMCP）中的模型作为代表性截面。内生技术变革现已成为大多数领先模型的特征。遵循新内生增长文献，以及将学习曲线应用于能源部门的做法，主要采用两个核心概念：知识资本和学习曲线。共同的观点是，技术变革由知识资本的发展所驱动，而知识资本具有部分非竞争性和部分非排他性的特征。内生技术变革有多种不同的实现方式。递归可计算一般均衡（CGE）模型在纳入内生技术变革和规模收益递增方面面临特殊困难。当前模型的主要局限在于：缺乏不确定性分析；对技术扩散的刻画有限；以及模型中行为主体的同质性，包括缺乏对创新过程中制度结构的刻画。

title: They Don't Invent Them Like They Used To: An Examination of Energy Patent Citations Over Time
venue: Economics of Innovation and New Technology
abstract: This paper uses patent citation data to study flows of knowledge across time and across institutions in the field of energy research. Popp (2002) finds the level of energy-saving R&D depends not only on energy prices, but also on the quality of the accumulated knowledge available to inventors. Patent citations are used to represent this quality. This paper explores the pattern of citations in these fields more carefully.I find evidence for diminishing returns to research inputs, both across time and within a given year. To check whether government R&D can help alleviate potential diminishing returns, I pay special attention to citations to government patents. Government patents filed in or after 1981 are more likely to be cited. More importantly, descendants of these government patents are 30 percent more likely to be cited by subsequent patents. Earlier government research was more applied in nature and is not cited more frequently.
abstract_zh: 本文利用专利引用数据，研究能源研究领域中跨时间、跨机构的知识流动。Popp（2002）发现，节能研发的水平不仅取决于能源价格，还取决于发明者可获得的已积累知识的质量。专利引用被用来衡量这种质量。本文更仔细地考察了这些领域中的引用模式。我发现，研发投入在时间维度和同一年内部均存在收益递减的证据。为检验政府研发能否缓解潜在的收益递减，我特别关注对政府专利的引用。1981年或之后申请的政府专利更有可能被引用。更重要的是，这些政府专利的后续专利被后来专利引用的可能性高出30%。早期的政府研究更偏向应用性质，且被引用的频率并不更高。

title: Institutions and Intellectual Property: The Influence of Institutional Forces on University Patenting
venue: Journal of Policy Analysis and Management

title: Lessons From Patents: Using Patents To Measure Technological Change in Environmental Models
abstract: When studying solutions to long-term environmental problems such as climate change, it is important to consider the role that technological change may play. Nonetheless, to date few economic models of climate change explicitly model the link between policy and technological change. There is a growing body of evidence that the incentives offered by prices and environmental regulations have a strong influence on both the creation and adoption of new technologies. In several recent papers, I have used patent data to examine the links between environmental policy and technological change. In addition, I have used the results of this research to calibrate the ENTICE model (for Endogenous Technological change) of climate change, which links energy-related R&D to changes in the price of carbon. Drawing on my experiences from empirical studies on innovation and from modeling the climate change problem, in this paper I review some of the key lessons from recent empirical work using patents to study environmental innovation and diffusion, and discuss its implications for modeling climate change policy. I conclude by offering suggestions for future research.
abstract_zh: 在研究应对气候变化等长期环境问题的解决方案时，考虑技术变革可能发挥的作用十分重要。然而，迄今为止，很少有经济学气候变化模型明确刻画政策与技术变革之间的联系。越来越多的证据表明，价格和环境监管所提供的激励，对新技术的创造和采用都有强烈影响。在近期的多篇论文中，我利用专利数据考察了环境政策与技术变革之间的联系。此外，我利用这些研究结果校准了ENTICE模型（即内生技术变革模型，Endogenous Technological change），该模型将能源相关研发与碳价格的变化联系起来。基于我在创新实证研究和气候变化问题建模方面的经验，本文回顾了利用专利研究环境创新与扩散的近期实证工作的一些关键经验，并讨论其对气候变化政策建模的启示。最后，我提出了未来研究的建议。

title: Uncertain R&D and the Porter Hypothesis
ENTICE: Endogenous Technological Change in the DICE Model of Global Warming
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management

title: Innovation and Energy Prices
Time In Purgatory: Determinants of the Grant Lag for U.S. Patent Applications
Forced Out of the Closet: The Impact of the American Inventors Protection Act on the Timing of Patent Disclosure
Pollution Control Innovations and the Clean Air Act of 1990
venue: Journal of Policy Analysis and Management
abstract: Although economists cite potential gains from induced innovation as an advantage of using market-based mechanisms to protect the environment, counts of patents related to flue gas desulfurization units ("scrubbers") peaked before trading of sulfur dioxide (SO 2 ) permits began. This paper uses plant level data to study the effect of these patents on pollution control.I find that requiring plants constructed before 1990 to install scrubbers created incentives for innovation that would lower the costs of operating scrubbers. There is little evidence that the new patents created before 1990 improved the ability of scrubbers to more effectively control pollution. However, patents granted during the 1990s, when market-based mechanisms were in place, do serve to improve the removal efficiency of scrubbers.
abstract_zh: 尽管经济学家认为，以市场机制保护环境所带来的诱致性创新是其优势之一，但与烟气脱硫装置（“洗涤器”，scrubbers）相关的专利数量，在二氧化硫（SO₂）排污权交易开始之前就已达到峰值。本文利用电厂级数据研究这些专利对污染控制的影响。我发现，要求1990年之前建成的电厂安装洗涤器，催生了降低洗涤器运行成本的创新激励。几乎没有证据表明，1990年之前产生的新专利提高了洗涤器更有效控制污染的能力。然而，1990年代授予的专利（当时市场机制已经到位）确实提高了洗涤器的去除效率。

title: Induced Innovation and Energy Prices
abstract: I use U.S. patent data from 1970 to 1994 to estimate the effect of energy prices on energy-efficient innovations. Using patent citations to construct a measure of the usefulness of the existing base of scientific knowledge, I consider the effect of both demand-side factors, which spur innovative activity by increasing the value of new innovations, and supply-side factors, such as scientific advancements that make new innovations possible. I find that both energy prices and the quality of existing knowledge have strongly significant positive effects on innovation. Furthermore, I show that omitting the quality of knowledge adversely affects the estimation results.
abstract_zh: 我使用1970至1994年的美国专利数据，估计能源价格对节能创新的影响。利用专利引用构建现有科学知识有用性的指标，我同时考察了需求侧因素（通过提高新创新的价值来刺激创新活动）和供给侧因素（如使新创新成为可能的科学进步）的影响。我发现，能源价格和既有知识的质量均具有显著的正向效应。此外，我表明，遗漏知识质量会对估计结果产生不利影响。

title: Altruism and the Demand for Environmental Quality
abstract: This paper asks whether individuals consider the value that future generations will receive from environmental quality when deciding what level of environmental protection to provide. Using data on life expectancy, I develop two tests for altruism towards future generations. One, a test for strong altruism, asks whether individual motives are purely altruistic when deciding to provide environmental quality. The second, a test for weak altruism, combines an individual’s concern for both self-interest and the interest of future generations. Using data from a Washington Post survey on environmental attitudes to implement the test, I find evidence of weak altruism. (JEL Q20)
abstract_zh: 本文探讨个体在决定提供多高水平的环境保护时，是否会考虑未来世代将从环境质量中获得的价值。利用预期寿命数据，我提出了两项利他主义检验。第一项是强利他主义检验，考察个体在提供环境质量时的动机是否纯粹利他。第二项是弱利他主义检验，将个体对自身利益和未来世代利益的关切结合起来。利用《华盛顿邮报》关于环境态度的调查数据实施该检验，我发现了弱利他主义的证据。（JEL Q20）

title: The Effect of New Technology on Energy Consumption
What is the Value of Scientific Knowledge? An Application to Global Warming Using the PRICE Model
